_comment: Shared defaults for stage records. A stage stores a field only when it differs. Phase 4 replaces the templated handoff/dependency text with stage-specific content. status defaults to 'stub': a stage is 'complete' only once it has stage-specific hand-written content (see docs/audit/PROGRESS.md).
handoff_requirements_template: Transfer {artifact} with source/revision, validation evidence, owner, limitations, unresolved risks and the next decision to the downstream role.
dependencies_template: Applicable policy, repository instructions and approved operating window
